title: prtop Launches: htop-Style Dashboard for Claude Code MRs
summary: prtop, a new terminal monitoring tool, brings htop-style real-time tracking to Claude Code merge requests, helping developers manage AI-driven workflows.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- prtop is a new terminal tool that monitors Claude Code merge requests using an htop-inspired interface for real-time workflow tracking.
- The tool addresses the growing need for visibility into AI-driven code review processes as Claude Code adoption accelerates in development teams.
- Available now on GitHub, prtop provides process-level monitoring for developers managing multiple concurrent AI code generation sessions.


A new terminal monitoring tool called prtop has launched today, bringing htop-style process visualization to[Claude Code](https://emergent.sh/learn/claude-code-review) merge requests. Officially released on November 17, 2026, the open-source utility provides developers with real-time visibility into AI-driven code review workflows through a familiar command-line interface.


## What prtop Does


prtop replicates the layout and functionality of htop, the popular Unix process monitor, but focuses specifically on tracking Claude Code's merge request activity. Developers can see active merge requests, their status, resource consumption, and processing times in a continuously updating terminal dashboard. The tool displays key metrics including request queue depth, completion rates, and session duration for each AI-assisted code review operation.


The utility fills a gap in developer workflows as teams increasingly rely on Claude Code for automated code generation and review. Unlike web-based dashboards or IDE integrations, prtop operates entirely in the terminal, making it ideal for SSH sessions, remote development environments, and minimal desktop setups where GUI tools are impractical.


## Technical Implementation


Built as a standalone CLI application, prtop connects to Claude Code's API to retrieve merge request data. The tool supports filtering by repository, branch, or user, allowing developers to focus on specific subsets of their workflow. Keyboard shortcuts mirror htop's conventions: arrow keys for navigation, F keys for sorting options, and customizable refresh intervals.


- Real-time updates with configurable polling intervals
- Color-coded status indicators for merge request states
- Resource usage metrics per Claude Code session
- Export capabilities for logging and analysis


The initial release supports GitHub and GitLab repositories where Claude Code is actively processing merge requests. Integration with other version control platforms is planned for future updates.


## Developer Adoption Context


The launch of prtop reflects broader trends in AI development tooling. As Claude Code handles increasing volumes of automated code reviews, developers need better visibility into these processes. Traditional git tools lack the real-time monitoring capabilities required for AI-driven workflows, where multiple concurrent sessions can generate dozens of merge requests simultaneously.


Developers working on large codebases with high merge request throughput will find prtop particularly useful. The tool helps identify bottlenecks, track Claude Code performance across different repositories, and quickly surface failed or stalled review processes that require human intervention.


## Availability and Roadmap


prtop is available now as an open-source project on GitHub under an MIT license. The tool requires Python 3.8 or later and authentication credentials for Claude Code's API. Installation is handled through pip, with Docker images planned for a December 2026 release. The development team has indicated support for additional AI coding assistants beyond Claude Code is under consideration for 2027.


## What This Means


prtop represents a maturing ecosystem around AI-assisted development tools. By bringing proven Unix-style monitoring interfaces to AI workflows, the tool makes Claude Code more transparent and manageable at scale. For teams already familiar with htop, the learning curve is minimal, while the visibility gains are substantial. As AI code generation becomes standard practice, purpose-built monitoring tools like prtop will likely become essential components of the modern developer toolkit.
